metadata.title: Weekly Anime · Your weekly anime release guide
metadata.description: Explore Japanese animated TV and movie releases by ISO week, with real ratings and streaming availability.

hero.eyebrow: A little less searching. A little more anime.
hero.title: Your next watch,
hero.description: A weekly look at anime airing in Japan and new movie releases. Find your next story and see where it’s streaming.

week.label: Week
week.subtitle: Japanese animation · TV & movies
week.cap: Showing up to 40 titles per week.
week.scope: TV matches air dates during this week; movie matches use primary release dates. Streaming availability is current and may vary by country.

state.setup: Connect TMDB to bring this week to life. Add TMDB_API_KEY or TMDB_READ_TOKEN to your environment, then restart or redeploy.
state.empty: A quiet week on the calendar
state.emptyBody: TMDB has no matching releases for this week. Explore the previous or next week for more anime.
state.errorBody: We couldn’t load releases from TMDB. Try again later or explore another week.
state.partial: Some release data could not be loaded. The available results are shown below.
state.omdb: IMDb ratings and vote counts show n/a until an optional OMDb API key is configured.
state.noProviders: No subscription, free or ad-supported streaming listed.
state.providersError: Streaming availability could not be loaded.

title.imdbErrorDetail: Could not retrieve the score. Try again.
title.imdbUnavailableDetail: No IMDb score is currently available for this title.
title.malUnavailableDetail: No MyAnimeList score is currently available for this title.
title.malErrorDetail: The MyAnimeList score is temporarily unavailable.
title.imdbUnmatchedDetail: No confirmed IMDb match for this title.
title.streamingLinksNote: Open this title on a service for the country shown. If a direct link is unavailable, view the regional watch options. Access depends on your location and subscription.
title.noWatchData: No offers found in the sources checked for this country.
title.streamingCountryHint: Show watch options for your selected country.
title.seriesWatchNote: These services list the series in this country. Check that the selected season is included before subscribing.

sponsor.label: Sponsor space
sponsor.body: A small space for partners who love anime.

footer.tagline: A new week. A new story.
footer.tmdb: This product uses the TMDB API but is not endorsed or certified by TMDB
footer.omdb: IMDb ratings: daily IMDb datasets · OMDb fallback
footer.anilist: Anime matching and fallback scores by AniList
footer.note: Release dates and availability come from the credited sources. No ratings are estimated.

notFound.title: That week isn’t on the calendar
notFound.body: Use an ISO week in yyyy-ww format, such as 2026-42.

error.title: Something interrupted the guide
error.body: Please try loading the guide again.

api.invalidWatchTarget: Invalid streaming title, country or provider

catalog.searchPrompt: Enter a title to explore the anime catalog.
catalog.noResults: No results available. Try another title or check back later.
catalog.seasonDescription: Explore anime by season, ordered by popularity.
catalog.seasonEmpty: No anime available for this season. Try another season or check back later.
catalog.availabilityNote: Streaming availability is current and may vary by country.
catalog.notFoundBody: Check the address or explore the seasonal catalog.
catalog.enrichmentUnavailable: Ratings and streaming services are temporarily unavailable.
catalog.imdbMissing: IMDb rating unavailable for this title.

trailer.heading: Trailer
trailer.unavailable: No trailer is available for this specific season or cour.
trailer.note: The video player loads only when you press play.

calendar.timezoneNote: Broadcast times are shown in your local timezone (Europe/Rome by default). TMDB episode dates have no time or timezone and are shown as supplied. Streaming dates can vary by service and country. Movies use the TMDB primary release date.
calendar.emptyDay: No confirmed release date for this day in the selected titles.
calendar.undatedNote: These titles appear in TMDB’s weekly selection, but no episode date inside this week was found in the available AniList or TMDB data. This may mean missing data, a break or a future season; it does not confirm a release this week.
calendar.partial: Some episode schedules could not be loaded. Confirmed releases are shown; other titles are listed below.
calendar.title: title

language.label: Language
language.error: The language could not be changed. Please try again.
language.originalSynopsis: Translation unavailable; showing the English synopsis.

explore.intro: Find your next anime by title, genre, season or score.
explore.optionalTitle: A title is optional. Combine filters to discover something new.
explore.scoreHint: Score filter uses the AniList average, converted to a 10-point scale.
explore.error: The catalog is temporarily unavailable. Your filters have been preserved.
explore.emptyHint: Try fewer filters or a different title.

newsletter.title: Your weekly anime inbox
newsletter.description: A weekly digest of titles to discover, with links to the guide.
newsletter.consent: I agree to receive the weekly newsletter. I can unsubscribe at any time.
newsletter.success: You're subscribed! Look out for the next weekly digest.
newsletter.comingSoon: Newsletter coming soon. Please try again soon!
newsletter.invalid: Enter a valid email address and agree to receive the newsletter.
newsletter.rateLimited: Too many requests. Please try again in a few minutes.
newsletter.error: We couldn't complete your request. Please try again later.
newsletter.unsubscribed: You've unsubscribed. You will no longer receive the newsletter.
newsletter.digestIntro: Titles to discover this week, with links to the guide.

myAnime.title: My anime
myAnime.description: This week's episodes from the anime you follow on Trakt and MyAnimeList.
myAnime.connectIntro: Connect an account to see your personal calendar.
myAnime.empty: No confirmed episodes or releases this week for the titles you follow.
myAnime.noFollows: Your list is empty. Add anime on Trakt or MyAnimeList.
myAnime.unavailable: We couldn't update all data ({providers}). Try again in a few minutes.
myAnime.authError: Connection failed or session expired. Connect your account again.
myAnime.unmatched: {count} titles have no verified AniList match.
myAnime.statsNote: Includes series with at least one watched episode. Hours include rewatches and use episode runtimes.
myAnime.statsPartial: Partial totals: some history or anime identities could not be loaded.
myAnime.statsMissingRuntime: Runtime missing for {count} plays; these are not included in hours.
myAnime.statsUnmatched: {count} titles could not be verified as anime and were excluded.
myAnime.refreshCooldown: Wait a minute before refreshing again.
myAnime.refreshError: Unable to refresh. Please try again.
myAnime.animeOnlyNote: Anime shows and specials only. Live-action series are excluded.

myFavorites.title: My favourites
myFavorites.note: Favourites are saved only in this browser: other devices keep a separate list.
myFavorites.empty: No favourites yet. Tap the heart on any card to find it here.
myFavorites.partial: Some favourites are unavailable right now.
myFavorites.calendarNote: Updates itself with new episodes. If you change your favourites, subscribe again.
myFavorites.transferNote: Open this link on the other phone or computer: it will ask to add the favourites to its list.
myFavorites.importNothing: You already have every favourite in this link.

features.topFiveDescription: Episodes released this week with the highest IMDb ratings. Updated daily.
features.episodesFewerThanFive: The ranking includes up to 5 episodes from the selected week with a verified IMDb rating. New ratings are checked once a day.
features.storageError: Unable to save your list in this browser.
features.noRatedEpisodes: No episode released this week has an IMDb rating verifiable through OMDb yet. We will check again at the next daily update.
features.episodesPending: This week’s episode ranking has not been updated yet.
features.episodesUnavailable: IMDb episode ratings are temporarily unavailable.
features.episodesPartial: Partial ranking: some IMDb episode ratings are not available yet.
features.episodesSourceUnavailable: OMDb cannot retrieve ratings for the new episodes yet. We will try again at the next daily update.
features.episodesQuotaUnavailable: The daily OMDb quota has been reached. Collected ratings remain cached; we will try again at the next daily update.
features.episodesAuthenticationUnavailable: The OMDb key is missing or was rejected by the service.
features.episodesMetadataUnavailable: Some episode dates or identifiers are not available yet. We will check again at the next daily update.
features.episodesDatasetEmpty: No episode released this week has a rating in the IMDb datasets yet. We will check again at the next daily update.
features.episodesDatasetUnavailable: The IMDb datasets are temporarily unavailable. Collected ratings remain cached; we will try again at the next daily update.
features.datasetAttribution: Episode ratings from IMDb datasets · updated daily

support.title: Support the site
support.description: Help keep Weekly Anime running, with no ads or affiliate links.

episodeChart.cacheError: The episode cache could not be read. Please try again.
episodeChart.title: Episode ratings
episodeChart.description: Episode ratings for the IMDb series:
episodeChart.scrollHint: Scroll to see more episodes. Select a bar to open its IMDb page.
episodeChart.note: IMDb episode ratings · daily cache. Only rated episodes are shown; numbering follows IMDb and may differ from anime seasons. The dashed line is the average of the displayed episodes.
episodeChart.noRatings: There are no rated episodes for this series in the latest IMDb dataset.
episodeChart.notCached: The daily episode index is not available yet. It will be populated by the next scheduled update.
episodeChart.noMatch: An exact IMDb series match is needed to show episode ratings.

dubbing.label: Dubbing
dubbing.missing: No verified dubbing information for this entry. Missing data does not mean no dub exists.
dubbing.identity: No verified MAL ID is available for this exact season.
dubbing.note: A dub is reported for this MAL entry. Availability on each platform and in each country must be checked separately.

seo.weekDescription: Anime releases, ratings and streaming platforms: {dates}, week {week}.
seo.platformsIntro: Choose where to watch and the streaming catalog country.
seo.platformDescription: Japanese anime series and movies ordered by popularity. Catalog availability may change. Data TMDB / JustWatch.
seo.platformEmpty: No anime available for this platform and country.
seo.platformUnavailable: The catalog is currently unavailable. Try again later.
seo.detailContext: Release schedule, episodes, streaming platforms and IMDb/MAL scores.
seo.animeFallback: Synopsis, ratings and where to stream {name}.

landings.weekDescription: This week’s anime releases, day by day, with formats, streaming platforms and ratings where available.
landings.bestDescription: Discover the best anime of the current season: up to 50 titles ranked by their available ratings.
landings.rankingRule: Rankings use the mean of available ratings on a 0–10 scale: IMDb and MyAnimeList out of 10, AniList divided by 10. At least one rating is required; ties are broken by vote count. Up to 50 titles are shown.
landings.weekEmpty: No releases are available yet. Check back soon for updates.
landings.bestEmpty: No rated anime are available for this season yet.

tierList.title: Anime tier list
tierList.heading: Tier list · {season} {year}
tierList.description: Rank this season’s anime in a tier list, then download the image or share it.
tierList.intro: Drag the posters into the rows. On touch screens you can also tap a poster, then tap a row. Your board is saved in this browser.
tierList.selected: Selected: {name}. Tap a row to place it.
tierList.empty: No anime are available for this season yet.
tierList.exportError: The image could not be created. Please try again.

rankings.title: Top airing anime · week {week}
rankings.description: Top airing anime in week {week}, ranked by IMDb and MyAnimeList scores with vote counts.
rankings.thresholds: Minimum: {imdb} IMDb votes and {mal} MyAnimeList ratings. Ties use vote counts, then AniList ID.
rankings.empty: No anime meet this list’s minimum vote threshold.
rankings.animeTitle: {name} release schedule, episodes and IMDb/MAL scores
rankings.animeDescription: Release schedule, episodes, streaming platforms and IMDb/MAL scores for {name}.
rankings.currentDescription: This week’s airing anime rankings ({week}), with IMDb and MyAnimeList scores and vote counts.

discovery.episodeTitle: {title} episode {n}: release date, time and where to watch
discovery.similarIntro: {count} anime from {season} with genres, tags or AniList recommendations related to {title}. Top result: {top}.
discovery.genreIntro: {count} {genre} anime in {season} ranked by IMDb, MyAnimeList or AniList scores. Top title: {top}.
discovery.similarRule: Genres and tags, AniList recommendations and score determine the order.
discovery.genreRule: IMDb and MyAnimeList scores qualify with at least {count} votes per source; qualifying scores are averaged. When neither qualifies, the AniList average score is used, converted to /10.
